extracted.name: Lomi Lomi Salmon
extracted.description: This Hawaiian lomi lomi is easy to make with smoked salmon, tomato, and onion for a refreshing fish salad or side. Perfect for a luau or any party!
instruction_lines: Stir salted salmon, tomatoes, white onion, green onion, sea salt, and cayenne pepper in a medium bowl. Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving. Serve chilled.
